title: Stage Johan Sports
description:
Do you enjoy working on a product that is actually used by customers, whether to add new features or to improve it? Do you keep going until you’ve created exactly what the customer needs and until it works well for everyone? Then we’re looking for you for an internship at Demcon Johan Sports. We offer you an internship where you will join the development team and work on part of the Johan Sports system to add a new feature or improvement. You will gain experience in a dynamic team and within a professional, multidisciplinary development environment where we are constantly working on the Johan Sports product, from embedded software to the UX and UI of apps, depending on your background.
Each one of our companies differentiates itself in its own domain with unique expertise and skills. This way they help customers improve their performance and achieve more. On the basis of their passion for technology our companies are able to combine forces. By sharing knowledge and working together we increase our social impact. Demcon johan sports is a developer of GPS tracking systems for monitoring the health and improving the performance of sports teams.
At Demcon Johan Sports, we have a multidisciplinary engineering team specialising in embedded software, front-end development, UI/UX design, back-end development and application engineering. We work together continuously to improve our Johan Sports PACER product and add new features.
Demcon Johan Sports sells PACER sports performance systems to professional football and hockey teams. Our PACER system consists of an embedded, a front-end and a back-end component. The tracker, equipped with embedded software, measures an athlete’s heart rate, acceleration and GPS data. The tracker transmits this data to a back-end, where we calculate metrics such as distances, sprints and heart rate recovery from the raw data. The back-end stores this information for each training session for the player and the team. The front-end displays this information to the coach or player via a website, Android app or iOS app.
As an intern at Demcon Johan Sports, you will be working on a new feature or an improvement to the PACER system. Depending on your background or education, you may implement an improvement or explore a completely new feature. We will discuss this with you to ensure it suits your skills and interests. Your assignment could range from improving the embedded GPS sensor driver, to redesigning one of the apps, to researching AI-personalised training advice for players in the back-end. We are constantly innovating, so there are many possibilities. You will need to create a design, possibly conduct research, and implement and test your solution. If everything works well, your result may be included in a release for the PACER system.
You will become part of the engineering team. You will work with colleagues from other engineering disciplines to integrate your solution into the PACER system. These are full-time internships and final-year projects. An exact start date will be determined in consultation.
Demcon Johan Sports and Demcon are a dynamic, growing and innovative organisation. You will be assigned a dedicated mentor to coach you, and we will clearly align all mutual wishes and expectations before the assignment begins. Furthermore, our standard working method gives you the opportunity to work within the team in a motivating working atmosphere. You will therefore get a good impression of what it is like to be part of Demcon Johan Sports and to work on a product. This could be a great start to your career.
If you're interested please let us know and send your cover letter and CV via the application button. For further information, please contact Tjerk Bijlsma, CTO at Demcon Johan Sports, at tjerk.bijlsma@demcon.com.

title: robotics engineer
description:
Are you an autonomous navigation expert? Do you have experience with robots and unmanned systems? Or do you want to apply machine learning to real problems? Join us in developing unmanned and autonomous systems!
DEMCON Defense & Security Systems (see defense & security - Demcon) collaborates with the Dutch ministry of defence on a number of themes: energy supply (electricity, heat, cooling) on large scale, such as for vehicles or bases, and on small (portable) scale; and autonomous systems, the development of technology for unmanned and (semi) autonomous systems.
As robotics engineer you will develop ‘autonomy’ for unmanned systems. This can mean localisation algorithms, route planning or simulation environments; or real-time analysis of camera images to determine where a vehicle can travel safely. Apart from this navigational autonomy, also the “high level” tactical behaviour of a vehicle can be made more autonomous. This vehicle could be a small scout robot, but also a larger vehicle that has to navigate autonomously, or even small drones that are controlled from a vehicle. You will become part of a team that works on all those aspects of autonomy in various projects. That means working with modern algorithms and software, sometimes straight from scientific publications, applied on real systems. The team works on things like:

In some projects we develop a simulator; in other projects we integrate algorithms on real unmanned vehicles of several types. Demcon also has two testing robots (indoor and outdoor rovers) for development and testing of autonomous functions.

title: Optical Engineer
description:
Do you have a strong interest in optical technology and want to contribute to optical innovations?
At Demcon focal we are looking for enthusiastic optical engineers for our location in Eindhoven
Demcon Focal is a high-tech development and engineering partner with a deep-rooted fascination for light, precision, and advanced imaging systems. We specialize in creating customized optomechatronic and vision systems, supporting our customers from the initial concept through to final assembly. By integrating optics/photonics, optomechanics and software into coherent and robust solutions, we enable technological progress in the most demanding applications. In doing so, we build on our extensive and fundamental knowledge of the properties of light.
As Optical Engineer you will develop complex optical systems for various customers. Typical applications include, but are not limited to:
You will be responsible for designing optical systems, performing trade-off studies, error budgeting and tolerance analysis. You will be involved in the full life cycle of product development, and you will contribute to the verification and qualification of the created solution. In addition, you provide technical content support to the project managers, both in the acquisition and in the transfer of the project result to the customer. title: Project Manager Unmanned Systems
description:
Due to our growth and the high level of interest in our systems, we are looking for a project manager.
At Demcon Unmanned Systems (DUS), we develop and manufacture advanced, electric and hybrid-powered unmanned autonomous vessels (USVs) for inspection, monitoring, and maintenance applications ranging from shallow inland waters to complex offshore environments. Our USVs are modular and custom-designed, based on our own technological innovations in autonomous navigation, the USV control system, remote operating centers, and system integration.
We offer flexible and future-proof solutions for a wide range of sectors, including maritime contractors, government agencies, defense, and security services. As part of the Demcon Group, we benefit from the strength and multidisciplinary expertise of a leading technology company. Our team consists of passionate professionals who collaborate to develop high-quality and innovative systems. In doing so, we contribute to a safer, more efficient, and more sustainable world on and around the water.
Due to a growing number of challenging projects, we are looking for an analytical, decisive, and results-oriented Project Manager. In this role, you will be the key figure in the development of innovative unmanned vessel systems and related projects, from concept to delivery. You will monitor the progress, quality, schedule, and budget of both commercial and R&D projects. You will coordinate with management and lead engineers, ensuring smooth collaboration among all stakeholders.
You keep a close eye on the project schedule and coordinate it with sales, service, R&D, and production activities. You anticipate changes in resources or deliverables and take the initiative in addressing them. You identify project risks, lead mitigation strategies, and ensure compliance with deadlines and quality standards. You regularly update stakeholders on progress.
What makes this role unique?
You’ll be based in Scheveningen, right in the heart of a high-tech waterfront environment in the harbor, with direct access to R&D and production facilities. This unique location allows you to adapt quickly, test innovations immediately, and make a real impact in a fast-growing market with rapidly evolving technology.
Your competencies
Team-oriented, energetic, accurate, results- and goal-oriented, strong in planning, organizing, and coordinating, good communication skills, commercially minded, and pragmatic.
At Demcon, we have a flat organizational structure where people easily connect and help one another. We value a pleasant and inclusive workplace. We provide plenty of personal attention and discourage overtime, because we know how important home life is.
